# Image Asset — Mars Research Control Room

Original file: `a_wide_cinematic_sci_fi_control_room_research_l.png`

Format in original package: PNG.

Description: A research and mission-control environment with a Mars globe, robotic system, analytical displays and an illuminated terrain model.

Presentation role: Represents intelligent engineering, multidisciplinary review and traceable mission decision-making.

Restored Version 1 concept: The control room symbolizes human-directed autonomy and adaptive responsibility. AI may perform increasingly capable analysis, but mission direction, risk acceptance, accountability, baseline authority and evidence-based release remain explicit.

Primary slide use: Intelligent Engineer Pro design-baseline case study.

Accessibility text: “A Mars mission-control laboratory with robotic assistant, analytical displays and a detailed terrain model.”

September 2026 alignment: The control-room image now represents the Engineer and Verify stages. It frames requirements, trades, design and testing as governed physical work, with human approval required before consequential baseline or release decisions.


---

## Version 5 use

Research/control-room imagery supports learning latency, parallel work, human review, and local autonomy. It should visually reinforce governed coordination rather than autonomous authority without approval.
